body:
I may have found something:

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/9296022fecadfbf82f15e837c215a1356eac4bc5/src/lib/routers/history.ts#L153

The callback `onPopState` uses `event.state` to know if it should read the URL or not.

The thing is I don't know where `state` comes from but in my case, hitting back button to a previous search gives `routeState = {}`, that is a truthy value but I am not sure that it is the behaviour we should expect from it?

EDIT:

I think that my problem is that `routeState` is an empty object whereas my state is not.
